title: OpenAI chemistry benchmark finds gains flattening between model generations
summary: MedChemBench, published by OpenAI on 20 November, scores 99 medicinal-chemistry problems drawn from 117 papers and patents and 761 molecular structures. At the shared xhigh reasoning setting GPT-6.2 Astra earned 84.5% of available credit, against 83.3% for GPT-6 Astra, 82.0% for GPT-6.1 Sol and 58.2% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Astra reconstructed molecular structures well, taking 95.4% of structure credit, but only about half the credit for ranking compounds and predicting numerical properties. The jump from the 5.6 generation dwarfs the step to 6.2.
